planets.name: Kepler-37 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-37 with a 21.3-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: Kepler-37 c was found in 2013 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-37. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONOMO_ET_AL_2023): disc_year 2013, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 21.30191004, pl_radj 0.0673567, pl_bmassj 0.00409026

quotes.title: Kepler-37c
quotes.card: Kepler-37c is an exoplanet discovered by the Kepler space telescope in February 2013.
quotes.introduction: With an orbital period of 21 days, it is located 209 light-years away, in the constellation Lyra.
